title: Collaborative-diffusion governance for street-connected children: evidence from Indonesia
core_idea: Evaluate whether a pentahelix collaborative intervention (government, academia, business, civil society, media) in Makassar enables durable protection and socio-economic reintegration of street-connected children, using a phenomenological design with interviews, observations, document review, and analysis guided by Rogers' diffusion-of-innovation attributes.
tldr: This study assesses a multi-stakeholder (pentahelix) intervention in Makassar (2021–2023) to examine if collaborative governance configurations support protection and reintegration of street-connected children, using qualitative methods and a diffusion-of-innovation lens to inform governance approaches in urban settings.
